name: War-fighting capacity
definition: Manpower, munitions, air defence and the state of active fronts
example_indicators: recruitment and losses per month; artillery rounds fired and produced; interceptor stocks; territory changes

name: Defence-industrial base and military spending
definition: Production capacity for weapons and munitions; adopted and executed defence budgets
example_indicators: military expenditure (% GDP, USD); 155 mm shell output per year; missile and drone production; defence procurement contracts

name: Alliance cohesion
definition: NATO, US–Europe, EU unity, US–Asia alliances; burden sharing and troop presence
example_indicators: US troops in Europe and Asia; NATO spending pledges met; EU unanimity votes; joint exercises

name: Escalation, deterrence, nuclear and arms control
definition: Incidents against NATO, nuclear signalling, arms-control treaties, proliferation
example_indicators: airspace violations; nuclear tests and doctrine changes; treaty status (New START successor, NPT, CTBT); enrichment levels

name: Energy flows and chokepoints
definition: Oil, gas, LNG and fuel supply; maritime chokepoints
example_indicators: Brent; TTF; EU and PL gas storage; chokepoint transits (PortWatch); OPEC+ quotas

name: Technology, compute, critical minerals
definition: Semiconductors, AI compute, export controls on technology, rare earths and critical metals
example_indicators: chip export controls; rare-earth export licences; fab capacity; AI compute access

name: Trade and economic coercion
example_indicators: tariff rates; sanctions designations (OFAC SDN); trade volumes between rivals

name: Fiscal-monetary capacity, debt, dollar system
definition: Budgets, deficits, debt, policy rates, currency and reserve systems
example_indicators: deficits and debt (% GDP); policy rates; USD share of reserves (IMF COFER); foreign holdings of US Treasuries; FX rates

name: Domestic stability and leadership
definition: Elections, succession, protests, repression, government changes in the powers that matter
example_indicators: election results; leadership changes; protest and repression events; approval ratings

name: Swing states and realignment
definition: Alignment choices of India, Japan, Turkey, the Gulf states, Brazil, Indonesia and the wider Global South
example_indicators: votes at the UN; arms and energy deals with rival powers; BRICS and SCO decisions; basing agreements

name: Regional wars outside Europe
definition: Middle East, Taiwan Strait, Korean Peninsula and other wars involving a great power or its partner
example_indicators: strikes and casualties; blockades or quarantines; PLA activity around Taiwan; ceasefire status

name: Slow stressors
definition: Food, climate shocks, demography, migration and health
example_indicators: FAO food price index; harvest shocks; extreme-weather losses; population and migration flows

name: Great-power negotiation channels
definition: Summits, talks, ceasefires and agreements between great powers
example_indicators: summits held; agreements signed; talks suspended or resumed
